results.snippet: On a GBP/JPY 1-hour chart during the London session, the indicator might show a red liquidity zone at 188.50. Price taps it, spikes to 188.35 (grabbing stops), then reverses 60 pips higher. That’s not random—it’s institutional order flow in action. The indicator works best when traders stop fighting liquidity and start anticipating its effects.

results.title: Order Flow Indicators and Oscillators in MT5
results.snippet: These indicators display Depth of Market (DOM) data in a layered format and clarify details such as resting volume at each price level, changes in bid/ask imbalances, and order queue behavior. By analyzing Cumulative Delta, changes in buying and selling pressure across different time frames are identified, enabling the detection of liquidity shifts between ranges. Some of these tools identify order clusters and zones of volume absorption or rejection, displaying them as a heatmap on the chart. The ability to overlay daily and session volume profile data and to show volume movement paths in market structure allows analysts to predict probable price direction.
